ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $O$ is a point on line $AB$, $\angle DOB = 90^\circ$, $\angle EOC = 90^\circ$. If $OE$ bisects $\angle AOD$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BOE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution:
\[
\because OE \text{ bisects } \angle AOD, 
\]
\[
\therefore \angle DOE=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOD=45^\circ,
\]
\[
\text{Also, } \because \angle BOE = \angle BOD + \angle DOE,
\]
\[
\therefore \angle BOE = \boxed{135^\circ}.
\]
